🎥🎬: Kung Pow! Enter the Fist (2002)

The Chosen One is a legendary martial artist whose family is brutally murdered when he is still a baby. Rescued and raised by a mysterious master, he grows up training in kung fu and eventually sets out to find the man responsible for destroying his family.

His journey leads him into a bizarre world of over-the-top martial arts battles, strange villains, and completely ridiculous situations. Along the way, he encounters the beautiful Ling and discovers that his greatest enemy is Master Pain, a powerful fighter who has his own connection to the Chosen One’s past.

As the Chosen One prepares for their inevitable showdown, his quest for revenge becomes an absurd battle of kung fu, destiny, and pure insanity. The result is a deliberately ridiculous parody of classic martial-arts movies.

source_details.synopsis: Kung Pow! Enter the Fist is a 2002 American martial arts comedy film that parodies Hong Kong action cinema. Written by, directed by and starring Steve Oedekerk, it uses footage from the 1976 Hong Kong martial arts film Tiger & Crane Fists (also called The Savage Killers) starring and directed by Jimmy Wang Yu, along with new footage shot by Oedekerk, who is also digitally inserted over Wang in many scenes, to create an original, unrelated plot. Despite a negative critical reception, the film was a moderate box office success, grossing $17 million worldwide against a $10 million budget.
